note.after_visit_summary: You are doing well 8 months after your heart stent. You have had no chest pain and your heart exam is normal. Your blood pressure today was 124 over 76 with a pulse of 62. Your main problem is high cholesterol, and your LDL was 118. That is too high because you could not keep taking your old statin, atorvastatin, due to leg aches. Those aches have gotten much better. We are starting two new cholesterol medicines: rosuvastatin 5 mg once a day, and ezetimibe 10 mg once a day. Keep taking your aspirin, clopidogrel, and metoprolol exactly as before. Do not stop the clopidogrel without calling us first. If your leg aches come back, stop the rosuvastatin and message us, but keep taking ezetimibe. You will need a blood test for cholesterol and liver function in 8 weeks. If your LDL is still above 55 at that time, we can talk about other cholesterol medicines. Come back to see us in 3 months. Continue your daily walking.
